description: Fork of exp266 (hybrid b=16 -> 1.5229 final) with device_batch_size 16 -> 32. Tests whether the 'denser per-row Adam statistics' effect from bigger batches keeps compounding. Memory estimate: ~55-60 GB peak on 80 GB H100 (tight; out_proj soft at NAP=6/tph=2048 is the limiting LUT). If OOMs, fall back to b=24. Comparators: exp257=1.6060 (all-soft b=8), exp265=1.6126 (hybrid b=8), exp266=1.5229 (hybrid b=16). Hypothesis: if compounding holds, exp267 lands ~1.49-1.50.
